native_versions.nginx:
nginx version: nginx/1.30.6
built by gcc 16.2.1 20260810 (GCC) 
configure arguments: --prefix=/tmp/cadentra-agent4-nginx-native/runtime --with-http_gzip_static_module --with-threads --with-http_realip_module

adaptations: Loads the strict nginx.production.conf, not the development default; static root points to this dist and listener is loopback8080.
Only the exact trusted ingress peer10.0.1.20 is changed to127.0.0.1 at its two reviewed occurrences; singleton/rewrite/strip guards are unchanged.
Startup probes and all browser/API contexts send public fixture CF-Connecting-IP198.51.100.77 to exercise native web ingress validation.
The real API remains APP_ENV=test in an isolated PostgreSQL schema; production API-peer/Traefik/Cloudflare/Docker deployment trust is not established.
Proxy-only upstream cadentra-api-proxy:8001 and Docker DNS resolution replaced with the real test API at127.0.0.1:8004.
Task-local wrapper supplies MIME/PID/log/temp paths; production routing/cache/header directives preserved.

environment.serving: Production dist served by native NGINX; real loopback API and isolated PostgreSQL schema

seed.postgresql: PostgreSQL 18.6 on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (GCC) 16.2.1 20260810, 64-bit

method.warm: 20 document navigations/interactions in one context after one excluded route warmup
method.cold: 5 fresh browser contexts with empty browser cache; valid actor cookies reused; server/OS/PostgreSQL caches remain warm
method.browser_ms: Navigation start through validated required API bodies, all observed API completion, exact visible data, fonts and two frames; includes initial navigation for filters/forms
method.api_ms: Independent same-origin GET and complete response body after each browser sample; expected status retained per endpoint
method.percentiles: Nearest rank; fresh-context n=5 p95 is maximum; sequential local measurements, not concurrent load
method.authentication: One real login per fixture actor cached only inside its mode0600 manifest; public forms anonymous; no repeated login/reset mutations
method.anonymous_401: Allowed only for /api/v1/auth/session on explicitly anonymous auth-form cases
method.reset: Public invalid sentinel renders form only; no real token or reset mutation

coverage_limits: All5000 subscriptions are ACTIVE; no other lifecycle-state-specific form latency is claimed.
Only authentication setup creates sessions. No financial, lifecycle, catalog, rule or account mutation latency is measured.
Reset uses a public invalid form sentinel; no real token, reset mutation or email delivery is verified.
Catalog/configuration tables have their recorded small fixture counts; these are not5000-product stress tests.

Strict production NGINX uses a native loopback trusted-peer adaptation and public fixture CF header; API remains APP_ENV=test. This does not verify real Traefik/Cloudflare, production API-peer enforcement, Docker or deployment.
